offlineProtection.explainerLead: You must leave your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) switched on and online during service.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen switches off, the device loses internet, or you move to another website, offline protection takes over — either by pausing ordering or by switching off auto-accepting orders, according to what you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Leave your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) switched on and online during service, otherwise offline protection may take over.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection switched on.

For orders to keep coming in, your screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection takes over in the way you chose.

Make sure “Keep screen on” is switched on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will continue — customers may place orders you cannot see. Only switch it off if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders when your device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses connection, this stops orders coming in while you can’t see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this vehicle loses its connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online ordering
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers can’t order until you come back online.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep receiving orders, confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accepting orders is switched off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You will confirm each order when you come back online — and any order still waiting is rejected automatically after the time you chose, and the customer is emailed to inform them.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The largest number of items your kitchen can turn out at one time, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s batch size still applies on top of that.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains within 5 minutes, set 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. This will still restrict your mains to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave at the ∞ symbol for there to be no limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & stock). Without that, capacity can’t know how long items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Add a vehicle in Settings › Vehicle settings to set your kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: The number of items your kitchen can make, so customers can only choose collection times you can meet.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: Should kitchen capacity be the same for all vehicles?
kitchenCapacity.confirmBody: All vehicles will use the kitchen capacity of {van}. Each vehicle’s numbers will be replaced.
kitchenCapacity.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward total capacity. Cooked categories always count; tick the instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
kitchenCapacity.countsLocked: Cooked — always counts (its prep and batch set the pace)
kitchenCapacity.countsNoCap: Set a capacity to choose which categories count
kitchenCapacity.countsUnavailable: Unavailable until the database is updated
kitchenCapacity.countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared limit of each window
kitchenCapacity.setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity to choose which categories count.
kitchenCapacity.categoryBatchAria: {hasCategory, select, yes {Items per batch: {category}} other {items per batch}}
kitchenCapacity.prepPerOrderHelp: The time one order takes to be prepared
kitchenCapacity.itemsAtATimeHelp: The number of items your kitchen can cook at the same time
kitchenCapacity.instantNote: Instant items aren’t counted toward kitchen capacity — customers get them immediately.
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Allow customers to cancel orders
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel up to <select></select> before their order collection time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order is moved to the next open slot. It only confirms where there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. allergy) will still need to be confirmed.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order-ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. The kitchen screen (KDS) is set separately, on each device. Customers are emailed whenever an order is marked ready. It applies to all events — you can still switch it on or off for one event on its dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you give out buzzers for order collection?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record the buzzer you gave each customer, so you know who to look for when their food is ready.
settingsCopy.buzzers.countLabel: How many buzzers do you have?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country can’t be changed later, because it is linked to your card payments.
whereYouTrade.countryGuessed: We guessed this from where you are. Change it if it isn’t correct.
whereYouTrade.townQuestion: Town or city where you are
whereYouTrade.saveFailed: Failed to save settings — please try again.
stockCopy.defaultScopeNote: The usual amount for every event. To set a different amount for one event, change it on that event’s dashboard — events you have already set an amount for there keep their amount.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.perDishBod: Review every dish and confirm its allergens. Customers see each dish’s labels plus an allergen summary card that comes from them.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.cardBody: Upload or paste one allergen card (PDF, picture or text), shown as it is. Each dish’s labels stay hidden.
manageSettings.walkthrough.title: New to HatchGrab?
manageSettings.walkthrough.body: A short tour of what is on each tab. It takes about one minute.
manageSettings.getApp.title: Download the app
manageSettings.getApp.body: The kitchen app runs your service on a phone or tablet — and it is the only way to keep receiving orders when you lose signal. It is free with your account, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
manageSettings.logo.label: Logo
manageSettings.logo.dropTitle: Tap or release a logo here
manageSettings.logo.removeConfirm: Remove your logo? Customers will see your food truck’s name without a logo. You can upload a new one at any time.
manageSettings.logo.removeFailed: Failed to remove the logo — please try again.

manageSettings.contact.title: Contact details
manageSettings.contact.intro: How customers reach you about their orders (shown on order confirmations) and where you receive new-order alerts. For your personal account details, go to Team → My profile.
manageSettings.contact.emailError: Please enter a valid email (e.g. habari@foodtruckyako.co.tz)
manageSettings.contact.emailHelp: Where you receive new-order alerts — and shown to customers on their confirmation when “Email” is the preferred method below.
manageSettings.contact.previousMethodGon: Your previous contact method is no longer available. Please choose a new one.

manageSettings.contact.tickWhatsApp: ⚠️ Tick “This number is on WhatsApp” in the Phone field to use WhatsApp.

manageSettings.preorders.intro: Allow customers to order ahead of an event. Set when pre-ordering opens and the deadline rules below — they apply only to the items you choose.

manageSettings.removeVan.preservedEvents: ✓ Kept: Records of past events linked to this vehicle are not affected.
manageSettings.removeVan.removedLink: ✕ Removed: This vehicle’s kitchen screen (KDS) link and its settings will be switched off.

manageSettings.vanBilling.body: Your plan ({plan}) includes {vans, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}. Adding an extra vehicle costs {price}.
manageSettings.vanBilling.note: ⚠️ We will contact you before charging anything.
manageSettings.schedule.title: Your schedule
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we will check it for you, and send you any events we find for you to approve. This should be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events listed somewhere else, we will still send them to you to approve. Nothing appears to the public until you confirm.
manageSettings.schedule.wherePost: Where do you post your schedule?
manageSettings.schedule.checkingHelp: This can take up to 2 minutes — please leave this page open and don’t close the tab.
manageSettings.schedule.urlHelp: Your website where customers can see your upcoming events — not a Facebook or Instagram page
manageSettings.schedule.exclusionsHelp: These words are filtered out automatically when you import your schedule. Remove any that were added by mistake.
manageSettings.qr.title: Order QR code
manageSettings.qr.domainLive: This QR code now takes customers to <mono>{domain}</mono>. You will never need to print a new one.
manageSettings.qr.domainNotLive: This QR code takes customers to your HatchGrab ordering page. If you set up your own website address later, the same QR code will take them there instead — you won’t need to print a new one.
manageSettings.qr.printHelp: Print or show this code so customers can scan it and place a pre-order. Put it at the window, on your food truck, or share it online.
manageSettings.qr.noUrl: No order link yet — your food truck’s page address isn’t set.
manageSettings.qr.brandedHelp: Your logo is shown in the middle of the QR code
manageSettings.qr.addLogo: Add your logo to your profile and it will appear here.
manageSettings.qr.lockedTitle: Codes with a logo are switched off for your food truck
manageSettings.qr.lockedBody: Codes with a logo are switched off for your food truck. Your standard QR code works exactly the same for customers — the only difference is your logo in the middle.
manageSettings.qr.buildFailed: That couldn’t be made just now. Try again after a short while.

manageReports.accounts.title: For your accountant
manageReports.accounts.help: Sales are counted on the day of the event. Gross sales is what customers paid. Net sales is what is left after refunds and tax.
manageReports.accounts.taxNone: No tax rate is set for your food truck, so tax isn’t calculated here.
manageReports.accounts.payAtTruck: Pay at Hatch (Pay when you collect)

manageReports.accounts.partial: Dishes without a cost are not included in the cost, so this profit is bigger than it really is. Add a cost for each dish in Menu.
manageReports.accounts.noCosts: No dish has a cost yet. Add a cost for your dishes in Menu to see your profit.
manageReports.accounts.eventNoProfit: A dash means that not every dish sold there has a cost.
manageReports.accounts.downloadHelp: Two spreadsheet files: one row for each order, and one row for each event. They open in Excel, Numbers, Xero and QuickBooks.

socialPosts.eventBoxBlurb: One picture for one event: its date, place and time.

socialPosts.imageChoicePrivate: Private events always use your standard design.

socialPosts.locationsPickOne: Choose a place on the left side to set its pictures.
socialPosts.eventBoxPhotoBlurb: It is put in the picture space in your single event design, cropped to fill it. Any shape is fine.
